en.name: AGRecorder
en.short_description: Simple audio recorder. Recordings stay on your device.
en.subtitle: Audio recorder, on-device
en.description:
AGRecorder is a simple audio recorder.

RECORD
One button. Start, stop, done. Audio is captured from the microphone as AAC and written straight to your device.

YOUR RECORDINGS
Every take is listed in Recordings, newest first. Play it back and scrub through it, rename it, share it through the system share sheet, or delete it. On iPhone and iPad the files also appear in the Files app.

KEEP THE APP OPEN
Recording runs while the app is on screen. If you lock the phone, switch apps or take a call, the recording stops and everything up to that moment is saved, and the app tells you why it stopped.

ON YOUR DEVICE
Recordings are saved in the app's storage on this device. There is no account and no cloud sync. Nothing is uploaded unless you choose to share a recording yourself.

PERMISSIONS, PLAINLY
Microphone access is what makes the app work. Your recordings are never uploaded by the app.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
AGRecorder is a simple audio recorder. It records microphone audio to an AAC (.m4a) file on the device, and its Recordings screen lists every take with playback, rename, share (system share sheet) and delete. Recording is foreground-only: locking the device, switching apps or a call ends the take, saves what was recorded, and shows a message saying why it stopped. The app declares no background modes.

Intended audience:
Audio recorder, on-device

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. The first screen has the Start Recording button; allow microphone access when asked. Tap Stop recording to save the take. The Recordings button below it opens the list of saved takes: tap the play icon to listen, and use the ⋮ menu on a take to Share, Rename or Delete it (delete asks for confirmation). On iOS the same files are visible in the Files app under On My iPhone.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
None for the app's features. Recording and playback use the on-device microphone and speaker, and recordings stay on the device unless the user shares one through the system share sheet. The app has no account, no backend and does not use location. Firebase Crashlytics, Analytics, Performance Monitoring and Remote Config are included for crash reporting, anonymous usage statistics and performance data.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
